name: copilot-managed-runtime
description: Skills and a guard-rail hook for building, governing and operating apps on Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime (ms CLI + @microsoft/managed-apps SDK): create, data sources, Dataverse, MCP/Work IQ, CSP, ALM/CI-CD, sharing, citizen-to-pro-dev handoff, orphaned apps, adoption, licensing and admin governance.

interface.shortDescription: Build and govern Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime apps
interface.longDescription: End-to-end skills for Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime: scaffold apps with the ms CLI, connect SharePoint, Dataverse, connectors and MCP servers, harden CSP, set up ALM and CI/CD, hand citizen apps over to pro developers, find orphaned apps and measure adoption. Includes a hook that blocks edits to regenerated codegen output.
defaultPrompt: Use $cmr-create-app to scaffold a Copilot Managed Runtime app
Use $cmr-review to check this CMR app against the anti-pattern catalog
Use $cmr-governance-admin to find orphaned CMR apps in my tenant
